fields.label: Options
fields.description: DocType for Link/Table, or the option list for Select

fields.label: Precision
fields.description: Decimal places for Float / Currency / Percent: shown with and rounded to on save (Currency: 2 by default; changing it changes the column)

fields.label: No history
fields.description: Changes leave no version or activity entry - for values the system keeps up to date (sync status, last run, logs)

fields.label: Don't copy
fields.description: Not carried over when the document is duplicated

fields.label: Set only once
fields.description: Once saved with a value, it can't be changed

fields.label: Mandatory depends on
fields.description: Required when the condition holds (JS, checked in the form)

fields.label: Read-only depends on
fields.description: Read-only when the condition holds (JS, checked in the form), e.g. eval:doc.status == 'Approved'
